message.reasoning_content:
need to read the facts and determine which crimes are directly supported.

Facts: Shao (邵某) colluded with transport department head Dong and a company chairman Ni, using positions to help Yang (董事长) of China Railway 15th Bureau to illegally win bids for two highway sections. They agreed to take a 3% kickback of the bid price, total 9.3 million yuan, split three ways. In Sep 2009, the company paid 1 million yuan as kickback, Ni got 0.5 million, gave 0.5 million to Dong. Remaining 8.3 million not paid due to Dong's case.

Prosecution says Shao is guilty of "受贿罪" (accepting bribes). They claim he is self-reporting, accomplice, attempted crime, etc.

We need to list crimes that this part of facts directly supports. The facts show: (1) acceptance of bribes (receiving kickbacks). That's "受贿罪". Also possibly "行贿罪"? But Shao is not the briber; he is the recipient. The bribe is given to Dong and Ni, but Shao also receives part? Actually they split 3% among three, so Shao also receives a share. So Shao is a recipient of bribes. So "受贿罪". Also "贪污罪"? No, that's misappropriation of public funds. Not indicated. "滥用职权" maybe? They used position to influence bidding, which could be "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power in bidding). In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power to facilitate illegal contracts). The facts: using position to help a company win bid illegally. That could be "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power for personal gain). However the prosecution only charges "受贿罪". The question: "只写这部分事实直接支持的罪名". The facts show collusion to manipulate bidding and accept bribes. The crime of "受贿罪" is clear. Also "行贿罪" is not applicable to Shao. "徇私舞弊罪" could be applicable to Dong (transport department head) and maybe Shao as a participant. But the facts mention "利用职务之便，帮助...违规中标". That is typical of "徇私舞弊罪". The Chinese criminal law article 397 (formerly) defines "徇私舞弊罪" for state functionaries who, using their position, facilitate illegal contracts, etc. So Shao, as a participant, used his position to help. So could be charged with "徇私舞弊罪". However the prosecution only mentions "受贿罪". The question: "请只针对这部分列出它构成的罪名。请先进行推理分析，然后将最终答案写在[罪名]和<eoa>之间。" So we need to list crimes that can be derived from facts. Likely "受贿罪". Possibly also "徇私舞弊罪". The facts: "利用职务之便，帮助...违规中标" - that is the act of abusing official power for personal gain, which is "徇私舞弊罪". So we can list both: "受贿罪;徇私舞弊罪". The format: [罪名]受贿罪;徇私舞弊罪<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: "贿赂罪"? That's generic term includes both "受贿罪" and "行贿罪". So not needed. "滥用职权罪"? Not a separate crime; "徇私舞弊罪" covers it.

Thus answer: [罪名]受贿罪;徇私舞弊罪<eoa>
